svg.text: Autonomous AI Software Engineer — Production Architecture
Solid border = internal runtime component • Dashed border = external service • All GitHub-mutating actions require prior HITL approval
3. LANGGRAPH AGENTIC CORE — single StateGraph, SqliteSaver checkpoint (backend/graph/runner.py)
Fallback only ever selects a credentialed provider; structured-output validation is never bypassed
Bounded self-correction: a QA failure routes to revision, which re-diagnoses and re-patches, then returns to qa (max 3 cycles)
Sandbox = process-level isolation: allowlisted commands, no shell=True, sensitive env vars stripped (not container/VM isolation)
LangGraph interrupt() — durable pause, not polling
SHA-256 diff hash re-verified before commit; drift → rejected
